fullDescription: A glassmorphic confirm-dialog system rendered over a living aurora: a near-black ink canvas lit by blurred aqua + magenta radial blobs, with every panel frosted glass (22px backdrop-blur), and a frosted Discard-this-design dialog floating over a blurred faux-app and a dimmed scrim, lit by its own aqua/magenta glow, on a full pattern-library page (anatomy, five-intent variants, copyable tokens).
prompt:
## Resumo A full glassmorphic-dialog landing page rendered over living aurora light on a near-black ink canvas: a sticky frosted nav, an editorial hero where a frosted-glass confirm dialog ('Discard this design?') floats over a blurred faux-app shell and a dimmed scrim against a soft aurora field, a three-card 'Anatomy' breakdown of the dialog's four planes (aurora field, scrim, frosted surface, top-edge hairline of light), a six-card 'Variants' gallery showing one glass surface across five intents (Confirm / Destructive / Prompt / Success / Upgrade / Share), a 'Design tokens' section pairing a swatch list with a copyable CSS code card, an aurora-backed CTA, and a hairline footer. Built on a two-type system (Space Grotesk for display + Inter for body) with a single ink surface (#0b0f14) and a two-hue accent vocabulary of aqua (#2dd4bf, confirms) + magenta (#e879f9, accents/warns); depth comes from 22px backdrop-blur glass surfaces, a colored dialog glow, large blurred aurora blobs, and a faint overlay grain rather than heavy chrome. ## Estilo Visual Use a dark glassmorphism design system on a near-black 'ink' canvas #0b0f14 (body text #e6edf3). The whole accent vocabulary is two hues plus a support indigo: aqua #2dd4bf (with #14b8a6 darker, #5eead4 / #a5f3eb lighter, confirm/safe/primary) and magenta #e879f9 (with #c026d3 darker, #f5c4ff / #f0abfc lighter, accent/warn/destructive), supported by indigo #6366f1 only in the aurora blobs. Two typefaces, both Google Fonts: Space Grotesk (weights 400/500/600/700) for the display family on titles, eyebrows and buttons (font-display, tight tracking), and Inter (weights 400/500/600/700) for body and UI; the type contrast IS the hierarchy. Render every surface as frosted glass: a primary `.glass` = linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(22,30,40,0.72), rgba(12,17,23,0.66)) with backdrop-filter blur(22px) saturate(140%), a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.10) border, and an inset top hairline of light (0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08) inset) plus a deep drop shadow (0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.7)); a lighter `.glass-soft` = rgba(255,255,255,0.035) fill, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) border, blur(10px). The signature backdrop is an 'aurora': three huge blurred radial blobs (an aqua #2dd4bf top-left and a magenta #e879f9 top-right, each ~60vw, border-radius full, filter blur(90px), opacity ~0.55; plus an indigo #6366f1 blob bottom-center, blur(100px), opacity 0.4), layered with a faint dotted grain (radial-gradient rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 1px on a 3px tile, mix-blend overlay) so the blur regions never band, and a radial vignette darkening the edges to rgba(5,8,11,~0.55). The hero dialog gets a special multi-layer 'dialog-glow' shadow: two inset white hairlines + a deep black drop + two colored glows (0 0 90px -10px rgba(45,212,191,0.35) aqua and 0 0 120px -10px rgba(232,121,249,0.30) magenta). The primary button is a vertical aqua gradient (#2dd4bf -> #14b8a6) with dark #06231f text and an aqua drop glow; gradient display headline text uses a 92deg #5eead4 -> #a5f3eb -> #f5c4ff -> #f0abfc clip with a soft magenta text-shadow. Radii: cards/dialog rounded-2xl, buttons/tiles rounded-lg/xl, chips rounded-full. Keep all chrome restrained: hairline white/8 borders, glass-soft panels, and small glowing 'dot' accents (box-shadow 0 0 10px 1px currentColor). ## Layout e Estrutura ### Sticky frosted nav A `
` wrapping a `border-b` hairline bar with `bg-ink/70 backdrop-blur-xl`, holding a `max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 lg:px-8 h-16 flex items-center justify-between` row. Left: a brand lockup = a 32px rounded-lg glass tile with a radial aqua+magenta glow wash and a white Phosphor ph:square-split-horizontal-bold icon, beside the Space Grotesk wordmark 'Modal' with an aqua '.' then 'design'. Center (hidden below md): four 14px white/65 links (Library, Anatomy, Variants, Tokens) that hover to white. Right: a ghost 'Sign in' link (hidden below sm) and the primary aqua-gradient 'Open canvas' button (font-display, rounded-lg px-4 py-2). ### Hero: aurora field + the floating frosted dialog A `relative isolate overflow-hidden` section whose first child is the `.aurora .grain` backdrop (the three blurred blobs) plus a radial top-vignette overlay. Inside a `relative z-10 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 lg:px-8 pt-16 pb-24 sm:pt-20 sm:pb-28`: a centered `max-w-3xl` block with a glass chip eyebrow (a glowing aqua dot + 'Prompt library · Dialogs & overlays'), a Space Grotesk H1 up to 60px ('Glassmorphic dialogs, rendered over ' where 'aurora light' uses the gradient text-grad clip), and an Inter white/60 lead. Then the centerpiece (next part). Below it, a centered trust row of three white/40 items with aqua/magenta Phosphor icons ('Copy as React + Tailwind' ph:copy, 'One prompt, on canvas' ph:sparkle, 'Focus-trapped & a11y-ready' ph:wheelchair). Close the section with a bottom fade gradient into #0b0f14. ### The floating frosted confirm dialog (the centerpiece) A `relative mt-14 sm:mt-16` stack with three layers. BEHIND: a blurred faux-app shell (`.faux-app .glass rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto`, aria-hidden, filter blur(3px) brightness(0.62) opacity 0.7) sketching a fake app — a toolbar row of grey/aqua pill placeholders over a `grid grid-cols-3 gap-4` of six h-24 rounded-xl white/4 tiles — so it reads as a real page behind the modal. MIDDLE: an `absolute inset-0 rounded-2xl bg-ink/40 backdrop-blur-[1px]` scrim. FRONT: an `absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center` holding the dialog — a `.glass .dialog-glow rounded-2xl w-full max-w-md p-6 sm:p-7` card with a top-right close button (ph:x-bold, white/50 hover white), a 48px rounded-xl icon tile with an aqua->magenta gradient fill and `ring-aqua` glow holding a #5eead4 ph:warning-circle-fill, a 20px Space Grotesk white title 'Discard this design?', a white/60 body ('This frame and its variations will be removed from the canvas. You can't undo this, but you can always regenerate from the prompt.'), and a `flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row sm:justify-end gap-3` action row: a glass-soft 'Keep editing' and the aqua-gradient primary 'Discard frame' with a ph:trash-simple-bold icon. Keep-editing renders first in DOM so on mobile the safe button is nearest the thumb. ### Anatomy three-card grid A `relative border-t` hairline section (id=anatomy). A `max-w-2xl` intro: an aqua Space Grotesk uppercase 'Anatomy' eyebrow, a 36px font-700 H2 'Every layer earns its blur.', and a white/55 paragraph naming the four planes (aurora field, dimmed scrim, frosted surface, top-edge hairline of light). Then a `grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-5 mt-12` of three `glass-soft rounded-2xl p-6` cards, each led by a 40px rounded-lg tinted icon tile (aqua/12 or magenta/12 fill) with a Phosphor icon (ph:stack-bold, ph:text-aa-bold, ph:lightning-bold), a Space Grotesk 18px white title (Layered depth / Two-type system / Intent in color) and a white/55 body line that explains the 22px blur / Space-Grotesk-vs-Inter / aqua-confirms-magenta-warns ideas. ### Variants gallery (one surface, five intents) A `relative border-t hairline overflow-hidden` section (id=variants) carrying its own `.aurora .grain opacity-50` backdrop. A header row (`flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between`): left, a magenta Space Grotesk uppercase 'Variants' eyebrow + a 36px H2 'One surface, five intents.'; right, a white/65 'Browse all 40 dialogs' link with ph:arrow-right-bold. Then a `grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5` of six `.glass rounded-2xl p-5` cards. Each card has a header row with a tinted chip label (aqua or magenta text) + a ph:dots-three-bold, then a `glass-soft rounded-xl p-4` mini-dialog specimen: Confirm ('Publish to library?', aqua check, aqua Publish / glass Cancel), Destructive ('Delete project', magenta warning, a magenta-gradient #e879f9->#c026d3 Delete / glass Keep), Prompt (a 'Describe your screen' input tray with a blinking aqua caret + '12 credits' + aqua Generate), Success (centered ringed aqua check, 'Exported to code'), Upgrade (aqua+magenta gradient crown tile, 'You're out of credits', aqua Upgrade / glass Later), and Share (an invite-link tray with a copy chip + an overlapping avatar stack). ### Design tokens (swatches + copyable CSS) A `relative border-t hairline` section (id=tokens) as a `grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 lg:gap-16 items-center`. LEFT: an aqua Space Grotesk uppercase 'Design tokens' eyebrow, a 36px H2 'The palette, made copyable.', a white/55 paragraph, then a `space-y-3` swatch list of three rows — a 48px rounded-xl swatch (bordered #0b0f14 'Ink surface', a glowing #2dd4bf 'Aqua · confirm', a glowing #e879f9 'Magenta · accent') beside a Space Grotesk label and a font-mono hex line. RIGHT: a `.glass rounded-2xl overflow-hidden` code card with a faux window title bar (three aqua/magenta/white dots + a font-mono 'dialog.tokens.css' label over a hairline border) above a `
` of syntax-tinted CSS that declares the :root tokens (--bg #0b0f14, --confirm #2dd4bf, --accent #e879f9, --glass-blur 22px, --glass-fill rgba(22,30,40,.7)) and a .dialog rule (backdrop-filter blur(var(--glass-blur)); box-shadow 0 0 90px -10px var(--accent)).

### Aurora CTA + footer
A `relative border-t hairline overflow-hidden` CTA section (id=library) with its own `.aurora .grain` backdrop and a radial bottom-vignette, holding a `relative z-10 max-w-4xl mx-auto px-6 lg:px-8 py-24 sm:py-32 text-center` block: a Space Grotesk H2 up to 48px ('Ship a dialog worth  on.' where 'tapping yes' uses the gradient text-grad clip), a white/60 lead, and two CTAs (the aqua-gradient 'Open the canvas' with ph:sparkle-bold + a glass-soft 'Browse the library' with ph:books-bold). Below, a `border-t hairline` footer as a `max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 lg:px-8 py-10 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4` row: the Modal.design mark (mini glass glow tile), a white/35 tagline 'A prompt library for glassmorphic product dialogs.', and three white/45 social icons (ph:x-logo-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:figma-logo-bold) that hover to aqua.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
The signature centerpiece: stack three layers so a modal reads as floating over a real page. BACK = a `.faux-app .glass` app shell sketched with grey/aqua placeholder blocks, then blurred (blur(3px) brightness(0.62) opacity 0.7) and aria-hidden. MIDDLE = an `inset-0 bg-ink/40 backdrop-blur-[1px]` scrim. FRONT = the `.glass .dialog-glow rounded-2xl max-w-md p-6/7` dialog, absolutely centered, carrying a top-right close (ph:x-bold), a gradient-fill ring-aqua icon tile (ph:warning-circle-fill #5eead4), a Space Grotesk title naming the action ('Discard this design?'), an undo-reassuring body, and a `flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row sm:justify-end` action row (safe glass-soft 'Keep editing' first in DOM, primary aqua-gradient 'Discard frame' second).

### Componente
A reusable `.aurora` layer (position absolute, inset-0, overflow hidden, z-0) that paints two large ~60vw radial blobs via ::before/::after (an aqua #2dd4bf top-left, a magenta #e879f9 top-right, each border-radius full, filter blur(90px), opacity ~0.55) plus a child `.aurora-blob3` indigo #6366f1 blob bottom-center (blur(100px), opacity 0.4). Pair it with a `.grain::after` dotted overlay (radial-gradient rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 1px on a 3px tile, mix-blend overlay) so the blurred color fields never band, and a radial vignette darkening the edges. Drop `.aurora .grain` behind the hero, the variants gallery (opacity-50) and the CTA.

### Componente
Two frosted-glass surface utilities plus a glow. `.glass` = linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(22,30,40,0.72), rgba(12,17,23,0.66)), backdrop-filter blur(22px) saturate(140%), 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.10) border, inset top hairline (0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08) inset) + deep drop (0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.7)). `.glass-soft` = rgba(255,255,255,0.035) fill, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) border, blur(10px). `.dialog-glow` adds two inset white hairlines + a deep black drop + two colored glows (0 0 90px -10px rgba(45,212,191,0.35) and 0 0 120px -10px rgba(232,121,249,0.30)) so the hero dialog appears lit from within by the aurora.

### Componente
A repeatable `.glass rounded-2xl p-5` card that frames a mini-dialog specimen inside a `glass-soft rounded-xl p-4` tray, with a header row (a rounded-full chip label whose text color encodes intent — aqua for safe/neutral, magenta for warn/destructive — plus a ph:dots-three-bold). Use it to show one surface across five intents: Confirm (aqua), Destructive (magenta, with a magenta-gradient #e879f9->#c026d3 button), Prompt (input tray + blinking aqua caret + credits chip), Success (centered ringed aqua check), Upgrade (aqua+magenta gradient crown), Share (invite-link tray + overlapping avatar stack). Same surface, color-coded action language.

### Componente
Primary button `.btn-primary` = linear-gradient(180deg, #2dd4bf, #14b8a6) with dark #06231f text, an aqua drop glow (0 8px 24px -6px rgba(45,212,191,0.55)) and an inset top highlight; brightens on hover. The destructive variant swaps to a magenta gradient (#e879f9 -> #c026d3). Headline accent words use `.text-grad` = a 92deg linear-gradient(#5eead4, #a5f3eb, #f5c4ff, #f0abfc) background-clip:text with a soft magenta text-shadow, so the aqua->magenta sweep ties headings back to the aurora and the buttons.

## Notas Especiais
Two typefaces, both Google Fonts: Space Grotesk (weights 400/500/600/700) as the display family (font-display) on titles, eyebrows and buttons; Inter (weights 400/500/600/700) for body and UI. Icons are Phosphor via Iconify (ph:square-split-horizontal-bold, ph:x-bold, ph:warning-circle-fill, ph:trash-simple-bold, ph:copy-bold, ph:sparkle-bold, ph:wheelchair-bold, ph:stack-bold, ph:text-aa-bold, ph:lightning-bold, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:dots-three-bold, ph:check-circle-bold, ph:warning-bold, ph:check-bold, ph:crown-simple-bold, ph:link-bold, ph:books-bold, ph:x-logo-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:figma-logo-bold). Exact tokens — ink surface #0b0f14, body text #e6edf3; aqua family #2dd4bf (base/confirm), #14b8a6 (button gradient end), #5eead4 / #a5f3eb (light); magenta family #e879f9 (base/accent), #c026d3 (destructive gradient end), #f5c4ff / #f0abfc (light); indigo #6366f1 (aurora blob only); primary-button text #06231f. Glass: `.glass` = linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(22,30,40,0.72), rgba(12,17,23,0.66)) + backdrop-filter blur(22px) saturate(140%) + 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.10) border + inset top hairline rgba(255,255,255,0.08) + drop 0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); `.glass-soft` = rgba(255,255,255,0.035) fill / rgba(255,255,255,0.08) border / blur(10px); hairline border = rgba(255,255,255,0.08). Effects: the `.aurora` backdrop (aqua + magenta ~60vw blobs blurred 90px opacity ~0.55 + an indigo blob blurred 100px opacity 0.4), a `.grain` dotted overlay (rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 1px on 3px tile, mix-blend overlay), radial top/bottom vignettes, the multi-layer `.dialog-glow` with two colored glows, a glowing `.dot` (box-shadow 0 0 10px 1px currentColor), and a `.ring-aqua` focus-glow. The whole page is a `sticky top-0` frosted nav over five max-w-7xl sections (py-20 sm:py-24 rhythm, hairline top borders) and reflows to a single column at smaller widths (hero headline drops its 
, all grids collapse 3->2->1, the dialog action row goes flex-col-reverse so the safe 'Keep editing' button is nearest the thumb, nav links hide behind the persistent buttons). Accessibility intent: aqua is the confirm/safe color and magenta the warn/destructive color, the safe Cancel/'Keep editing' button gets default visual weight and DOM-first order on mobile, and the dialog states the action + an undo-reassuring consequence in words rather than relying on color alone.

layout_and_structure.description: A single scrolling product page anchored by a `sticky top-0 z-50` frosted nav, then five full-bleed sections each on a centered `max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 lg:px-8` container with a `py-20 sm:py-24` rhythm and hairline top borders: (1) a centered hero with an eyebrow chip + gradient-accent headline + lead, then the centerpiece — a blurred faux-app shell with a dimmed scrim and the frosted confirm dialog absolutely centered over it, closed by a 3-item trust row; (2) an 'Anatomy' section with a left intro block over a 1->3-col glass-soft card grid; (3) a 'Variants' gallery on its own aurora field with a header row (title + 'browse all 40' link) and a 1->2->3-col grid of six glass cards, each holding a mini-dialog specimen; (4) a 'Design tokens' two-column split pairing a swatch list (left) with a copyable CSS code card (right); (5) an aurora-backed centered CTA. Closed by a hairline footer that reflows to a column on mobile. The page reflows cleanly to a single column at smaller widths (the hero headline drops its line break, grids collapse 3->2->1, the dialog action row goes `flex-col-reverse` so the safe 'Keep editing' button is nearest the thumb, and the nav links hide behind the persistent buttons).

Then a `grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5` of six `.glass rounded-2xl p-5` cards. Each card has a header row with a tinted chip label (aqua or magenta text) + a ph:dots-three-bold, then a `glass-soft rounded-xl p-4` mini-dialog specimen: Confirm ('Publish to library?', aqua check, aqua Publish / glass Cancel), Destructive ('Delete project', magenta warning, a magenta-gradient #e879f9->#c026d3 Delete / glass Keep), Prompt (a 'Describe your screen' input tray with a blinking aqua caret + '12 credits' + aqua Generate), Success (centered ringed aqua check, 'Exported to code'), Upgrade (aqua+magenta gradient crown tile, 'You're out of credits', aqua Upgrade / glass Later), and Share (an invite-link tray with a copy chip + an overlapping avatar stack).

A `relative border-t hairline` section (id=tokens) as a `grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 lg:gap-16 items-center`. LEFT: an aqua Space Grotesk uppercase 'Design tokens' eyebrow, a 36px H2 'The palette, made copyable.', a white/55 paragraph, then a `space-y-3` swatch list of three rows — a 48px rounded-xl swatch (bordered #0b0f14 'Ink surface', a glowing #2dd4bf 'Aqua · confirm', a glowing #e879f9 'Magenta · accent') beside a Space Grotesk label and a font-mono hex line. RIGHT: a `.glass rounded-2xl overflow-hidden` code card with a faux window title bar (three aqua/magenta/white dots + a font-mono 'dialog.tokens.css' label over a hairline border) above a `<pre>` of syntax-tinted CSS that declares the :root tokens (--bg #0b0f14, --confirm #2dd4bf, --accent #e879f9, --glass-blur 22px, --glass-fill rgba(22,30,40,.7)) and a .dialog rule (backdrop-filter blur(var(--glass-blur)); box-shadow 0 0 90px -10px var(--accent)).

prompts.partPt: Aurora Chamada Final para Ação + Rodapé
prompts.prompt: A `relative border-t hairline overflow-hidden` CTA section (id=library) with its own `.aurora .grain` backdrop and a radial bottom-vignette, holding a `relative z-10 max-w-4xl mx-auto px-6 lg:px-8 py-24 sm:py-32 text-center` block: a Space Grotesk H2 up to 48px ('Ship a dialog worth <tapping yes> on.' where 'tapping yes' uses the gradient text-grad clip), a white/60 lead, and two CTAs (the aqua-gradient 'Open the canvas' with ph:sparkle-bold + a glass-soft 'Browse the library' with ph:books-bold). Below, a `border-t hairline` footer as a `max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 lg:px-8 py-10 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4` row: the Modal.design mark (mini glass glow tile), a white/35 tagline 'A prompt library for glassmorphic product dialogs.', and three white/45 social icons (ph:x-logo-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:figma-logo-bold) that hover to aqua.

special_ui_components.prompt: The signature centerpiece: stack three layers so a modal reads as floating over a real page. BACK = a `.faux-app .glass` app shell sketched with grey/aqua placeholder blocks, then blurred (blur(3px) brightness(0.62) opacity 0.7) and aria-hidden. MIDDLE = an `inset-0 bg-ink/40 backdrop-blur-[1px]` scrim. FRONT = the `.glass .dialog-glow rounded-2xl max-w-md p-6/7` dialog, absolutely centered, carrying a top-right close (ph:x-bold), a gradient-fill ring-aqua icon tile (ph:warning-circle-fill #5eead4), a Space Grotesk title naming the action ('Discard this design?'), an undo-reassuring body, and a `flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row sm:justify-end` action row (safe glass-soft 'Keep editing' first in DOM, primary aqua-gradient 'Discard frame' second).

A reusable `.aurora` layer (position absolute, inset-0, overflow hidden, z-0) that paints two large ~60vw radial blobs via ::before/::after (an aqua #2dd4bf top-left, a magenta #e879f9 top-right, each border-radius full, filter blur(90px), opacity ~0.55) plus a child `.aurora-blob3` indigo #6366f1 blob bottom-center (blur(100px), opacity 0.4). Pair it with a `.grain::after` dotted overlay (radial-gradient rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 1px on a 3px tile, mix-blend overlay) so the blurred color fields never band, and a radial vignette darkening the edges. Drop `.aurora .grain` behind the hero, the variants gallery (opacity-50) and the CTA.

Two frosted-glass surface utilities plus a glow. `.glass` = linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(22,30,40,0.72), rgba(12,17,23,0.66)), backdrop-filter blur(22px) saturate(140%), 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.10) border, inset top hairline (0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08) inset) + deep drop (0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.7)). `.glass-soft` = rgba(255,255,255,0.035) fill, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) border, blur(10px). `.dialog-glow` adds two inset white hairlines + a deep black drop + two colored glows (0 0 90px -10px rgba(45,212,191,0.35) and 0 0 120px -10px rgba(232,121,249,0.30)) so the hero dialog appears lit from within by the aurora.

A repeatable `.glass rounded-2xl p-5` card that frames a mini-dialog specimen inside a `glass-soft rounded-xl p-4` tray, with a header row (a rounded-full chip label whose text color encodes intent — aqua for safe/neutral, magenta for warn/destructive — plus a ph:dots-three-bold). Use it to show one surface across five intents: Confirm (aqua), Destructive (magenta, with a magenta-gradient #e879f9->#c026d3 button), Prompt (input tray + blinking aqua caret + credits chip), Success (centered ringed aqua check), Upgrade (aqua+magenta gradient crown), Share (invite-link tray + overlapping avatar stack). Same surface, color-coded action language.

Primary button `.btn-primary` = linear-gradient(180deg, #2dd4bf, #14b8a6) with dark #06231f text, an aqua drop glow (0 8px 24px -6px rgba(45,212,191,0.55)) and an inset top highlight; brightens on hover. The destructive variant swaps to a magenta gradient (#e879f9 -> #c026d3). Headline accent words use `.text-grad` = a 92deg linear-gradient(#5eead4, #a5f3eb, #f5c4ff, #f0abfc) background-clip:text with a soft magenta text-shadow, so the aqua->magenta sweep ties headings back to the aurora and the buttons.

structured.special_notes:
Two typefaces, both Google Fonts: Space Grotesk (weights 400/500/600/700) as the display family (font-display) on titles, eyebrows and buttons; Inter (weights 400/500/600/700) for body and UI. Icons are Phosphor via Iconify (ph:square-split-horizontal-bold, ph:x-bold, ph:warning-circle-fill, ph:trash-simple-bold, ph:copy-bold, ph:sparkle-bold, ph:wheelchair-bold, ph:stack-bold, ph:text-aa-bold, ph:lightning-bold, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:dots-three-bold, ph:check-circle-bold, ph:warning-bold, ph:check-bold, ph:crown-simple-bold, ph:link-bold, ph:books-bold, ph:x-logo-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:figma-logo-bold). Exact tokens — ink surface #0b0f14, body text #e6edf3; aqua family #2dd4bf (base/confirm), #14b8a6 (button gradient end), #5eead4 / #a5f3eb (light); magenta family #e879f9 (base/accent), #c026d3 (destructive gradient end), #f5c4ff / #f0abfc (light); indigo #6366f1 (aurora blob only); primary-button text #06231f. Glass: `.glass` = linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(22,30,40,0.72), rgba(12,17,23,0.66)) + backdrop-filter blur(22px) saturate(140%) + 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.10) border + inset top hairline rgba(255,255,255,0.08) + drop 0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); `.glass-soft` = rgba(255,255,255,0.035) fill / rgba(255,255,255,0.08) border / blur(10px); hairline border = rgba(255,255,255,0.08). Effects: the `.aurora` backdrop (aqua + magenta ~60vw blobs blurred 90px opacity ~0.55 + an indigo blob blurred 100px opacity 0.4), a `.grain` dotted overlay (rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 1px on 3px tile, mix-blend overlay), radial top/bottom vignettes, the multi-layer `.dialog-glow` with two colored glows, a glowing `.dot` (box-shadow 0 0 10px 1px currentColor), and a `.ring-aqua` focus-glow. The whole page is a `sticky top-0` frosted nav over five max-w-7xl sections (py-20 sm:py-24 rhythm, hairline top borders) and reflows to a single column at smaller widths (hero headline drops its
, all grids collapse 3->2->1, the dialog action row goes flex-col-reverse so the safe 'Keep editing' button is nearest the thumb, nav links hide behind the persistent buttons). Accessibility intent: aqua is the confirm/safe color and magenta the warn/destructive color, the safe Cancel/'Keep editing' button gets default visual weight and DOM-first order on mobile, and the dialog states the action + an undo-reassuring consequence in words rather than relying on color alone.
